name: Maria Elisabeth Pfeiffer

events.place: Przystajnia, Kalisz Powiat, Kalisz Department, Duchy of Warsaw
Przystajnia, Kalisz Powiat, Kalisz Department, Duchy of Warsaw

notes: Family History Centre: Refer to LDS Film # 758374, Record # 48, which records the September 23, 1813 birth of Maria Elisabeth Pfeiffer to parents Christian Pfeiffer 26 years old who lives in Pryzranie and his wife Beate Luise, nee (Buschen) 21 years old.  Witnesses were Jacob Mueller, 59, and Gottfried Zielke, 34, both living in Pryzranie.
